items.text: Have you missed out on Kitty’s birthday celebration? Worry not! The party is going to keep going until June 12th, making it a whole month of birthday!
If you haven’t yet, be sure you open your gifts in the apartment and get your Party Hat before you can’t get it anymore!
The party decorations will come down on June 12th.
In this update, we’ve expanded the apartment area, adding several interactables including a TV, record player, and musical instruments. Cause some mew-sical chaos and flip TV channels!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38001328/63fcb2f4e8dc71a7168b7e7be116d11eea49d9b9.jpg"]Oh, and who’s this? Meet Turt, your chatty turtle roommate. She's got a lot of thoughts on home improvement!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38001328/9563b2f0a9bd87b02b2ae6cead08acf213ecf682.jpg"]For Kitty’s birthday, we’ve added tons of little festive treats to the apartment. Enjoy cake, grab a party blower, pop balloons, and don’t forget to open your presents for a party hat!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38001328/b59d274be0c23ea55f838e25539862d0f0e218bd.png"]Additionally, you can now teleport to the apartment after completing your climb.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38001328/aa850023fbf41ddb5854aa4ec0323b52d05d2c18.jpg"]Don’t forget to catch some Z’s in the new nap spot, too!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38001328/3db4aa7fff602d05b4c15c203970f12c1c14f5ae.jpg"]Maybe you can learn something from this lucky cat figurine while you’re at it?
Of course, we’ve added some fun new stickers and frames to play with and add a celebratory birthday touch to all of your photos. Give everyone party hats!!

A highly requested feature is finally here: you can now start and play through the entire game as your custom cat, giving your next playthrough a personalized twist. Give it a try! Whether you play as your own kitty, a fictional kitty, or a colorful abomination, you’ll see the Big City through fresh eyes.

notes.title: The Amazing Digital Circus x Little Kitty, Big City

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38001328/94f7a9ba3da74c7d838cc28cd85f756e6d767d8f.jpg"]

Who’s that weird purple bunny?! In collaboration with our friends over at Glitch, we’ve included a free Jax hat and skin! You can find the Purple Bunny Hat already in your inventory, and obtain the skin in the customizer using the code ‘VEGAN’.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38001328/d58caf9cf39ad450730ae738859b22f9c8cf6553.jpg"]

You can also find a cute little Pomni plush in Kitty’s apartment! What you do with her, however, is up to you. Drop her from high heights? Bat her around and into puddles? I’m not going to influence your decisions there…

You can now find Bing-Bong abandoned behind a trash can. No, I’m serious! Challenge yourself by taking Bing-Bong to new heights and see how far you’ll climb with him. Will you take him all the way home, or dump him? The choice is yours.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38001328/ece25c0b195842b6499b911af230eced2513c92d.png"]

We’ve got some sweet new swag in our store, including some adorable embroidered pins, sticker packs, and a sick print in collaboration with the legendary Attack Peter, featuring our favorite gecko kaiju (Geiju??)

Every order placed on the official Little Kitty, Big City Shopify Store on Tuesday, May 12th will include a free adorable birthday sticker while supplies last. This gift with purchase offer is only valid for orders placed on May 12th. Limited quantities available. First come, first served.

If you’re in the Seattle area, Kitty is having a real life birthday party at Neko Cat Cafe on May 18th, from 3 PM to 8 PM. Come enjoy some treats and hang out with some adorable kitties while celebrating our very own Kitty! There will be demo stations available, gashapon machines with prizes, and a prize wheel to spin! You can play the game as the cafe’s resident kitties, Prairie, Ringo and Zest!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38001328/65db18b0249c004a74aeb04d44e21b5e126fcdac.jpg"]

To tie it all up we’ve having the ultimate contest on our Discord, a combination fanart + photo contest! Snap some birthday party pics in-game OR create some celebratory fanart. It’s up to you, and you can do it for a-meow-zing prizes!
Happy Birthday to Kitty!!! 🎉🎂🎈As an anniversary treat, we’ve added all new birthday-themed content! And a few additional surprises.
The rest of the Kitty's apartment interior is now accessible
Added a new NPC friend to Kitty's apartment
Added seasonal interactables including balloons, cake, a present, and a party blower
Added more fun things to interact with including a TV, a record player, musical instruments and more
Added a new birthday-themed hat and sticker pack
Added a new nap spot
Added a new emote
A new teleport portal has been added to Kitty's home for easy access back to the apartment
Ducklings now respond to Kitty's meows when they are following
Custom skins can now be selected/worn on start for players who have already reached home at least once
An interactable beach ball and bubble blower can now be found in the main city area
Huh?? Who’s this purple bunny?? We’ve also added a Jax hat, a Jax skin (unlock via the code: VEGAN), and an interactable Pomni plush, courtesy of our friends at Digital Circus and Glitch Productions!

And last but not least… Bing Bong? Your favorite stuffed... whatever he is... from the smash hit PEAK has been added as an interactable plush! Can you find him and help him get to the PEAK?? Thanks to our friends at Aggro Crab Games and Landfall Games!

releases.displayName: Year of the Fire Horse Lunar New Year Update!

items.text: Gallop into the Year of the Fire Horse with Kitty! It would behoove you to don this special Fire Horse hat and snap some festive pictures with a new Lunar New Year- themed Photo Mode pack, complete with 5 new stickers and a frame. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38001328/bf4e7c7d028c9878bc0897aa922fcfc64078d421.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38001328/bdb68d1258afb1b024f93faa53b92dc5449b90af.jpg"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38001328/52a2ffca0ec157d83eb03f21f3f65f3a86e9be53.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38001328/0741afa93253c76ccf39273d34ca6dd2718925e1.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38001328/799fac6aa2fefcd350e938077c54ed7503f34281.jpg"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38001328/60793938258dfa509dedc95bea961945d0c7061a.png"]

It’s not just the devs who are preparing for the holidays. Watch our new Animated Holiday Short on Friday, December 19th on YouTube to find out what Kitty and Friends are up to while the humans are out and about!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38001328/0b320536dbc251dec423f5a19b2dd08508895602.png"]

We’ve also tried to make your gift shopping a little easier. PC players can now click a button on the game’s main menu to see whether friends have Little Kitty, Big City on their Steam Wishlist. We’re a little biased, but we think our furry friend is the perfect present for any cat fan! 🎁😻
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38001328/d3211536de75245b497c98568fcda8b65ecc6723.png"]

Check out our new wardrobe assist! We’re adding nine preset cat skins to give you a head start when customizing your Kitty. NINE! (Like nine lives, get it?) Use them as-is to get a makeover in moments, or as the foundation for a bold new look!

And we added more templates! Every feline fashionista needs more closet space, so we’ve DOUBLED the number of custom skins you can create! The 6 skin limit for consoles is now 12, and PC players go from 20 slots to an whopping 40!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38001328/fba784179549eb74d05ea4688192c029bcaa313e.png"]
‘Tis the season for wrapping, so we’ve added a wrap feature to the Kitty customizer! It’ll let markings wrap around Kitty’s body, making patterns like ringed tails or striped legs a total breeze.

We also heard that cool shapes were going to be HUGE in 2026, so we’ve added a star and a swirl to our range of markings! They’ll be perfect for celestial Kitty looks AND distressingly bright ‘90s arcade carpet-inspired fur… ⭐️💫

Last (but DEFINITELY not least), we’ve improved the customizer camera. It should now autofocus on the marking that you’re placing, meaning it’s easier to do fine detail work in awkward places. No more straining to see Kitty's armpit!
We are having a festive Holiday Card Contest over on our Discord for some awesome prizes. Come pop by!

releases.displayName: Little Kitty, Big City: The Picture Purrfect Update is OUT NOW!

items.text: [img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeNtfHRzjx7YYY3acBC8kZ_ix64U7RbYaXWG4J2gyDuG36qcedUM_ATlExsg4v7tD7__TNpaXrCNZs3YMmpby-HIojHbXLHD3le2GnCKDMBN-sAdwKHUy4vtIvMS44vJfit25QisQ?key=uo_qC-GnuFJwZVMFWQtwzg"]
Meowdy, everyone!
We are DELIGHTED to meow-nnounce that the Picture Purrfect Update for Little Kitty, Big City is OUT NOW and it's COMPLETELY FREE!

You can now customize your Kitty using Tanuki's exciting new technology! Pick your favorite fur color, add a cool coat pattern, start a trend for bright green toe beans, or lovingly replicate your own beloved pet with a design of your very own! We're even giving you the ability to adjust eye color and pupil shape for each eye separately – a win for odd-eyed cats everywhere!

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfNwjheq16kyqUJqS8LQCRKVk1Lo2Q99m4cZi2MOoGIjYlhkeVpWWnJknjeaumoDTSxKIhlCx83FCnscHOGheEN_r3rwz5UCHf9WaS61ctybq-4vNu2xoqckG_UdN1Dj8uePevUOA?key=uo_qC-GnuFJwZVMFWQtwzg"]

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXed9HRzokqwKNMoLr4XPugbnD2sbJxkAo7wZZAKU2GxfNu0UjBvp5D-E0vQncDUWx1g1xDwbA3Ej3e44aqvxnFzx25P8kh2lrrM6pI6zXmrNWfLKFpegU5ZxcxHEuG4hQ740d9Mlg?key=uo_qC-GnuFJwZVMFWQtwzg"]
You'll visit even more of the city, thanks to the new areas included in the Picture Purrfect Update!

A residential part of the neighborhood gives you fresh insight into Doggo's day-to-day activities, and introduces you to a chaotic sibling double-act – one's a tech prodigy on a par with Tanuki, the other's a being of pure chaos!

We've also opened up two interior environments, each packed with surprises! Dare you play with the unpredictable inventions in Tanuki's secret workshop? Or would you prefer to scamper around the palatial home of fluffy super-influencer Taffy as she glares from her cat basket of despair? Only one way to find out…!

notes.title: In addition to the above, the update also brings

items.text: New quests!
New hats!
New emotes!

notes.title: How do I find the new stuff?

items.text: New players: The Picture Purrfect Update content fits seamlessly into the base game, so you'll discover everything from the update as you play. Have fun!
Existing players: Welcome back! All you need to do is make sure you've polished off the To-Do list items for Beetle, Tanuki, and Big Potato (if you know, you know…)!

We couldn’t be more grateful for all of the support we’ve received from our wonderful community since Little Kitty, Big City first launched, and The Picture Purrfect Update is just a small way for us to show our appreciation.
We look forward to seeing all your customized Kitties and your gorgeous/cursed photo mode creations!
Love, Team LKBC xxxxx

Animation improvements and fixes

Player settings now validated before loading
Improved overall save logic which fixes players unable to load the game if their save got corrupted (loss of power, etc)
* If the save fails to validate/load, a backup will be loaded if it exists
* If the backup fails to load, or doesn't exist, the problematic save will be deleted. this should prevent on-game-start issues with bad save files. this is the worst case scenario
* A backup is created (ie: SaveFile_0.es3.bac)
* The game is saved to file
* The file is validated, and if it fails to validate (ie: we read a value from it) then the backup is restored. backups are also validated before being restored
logging added to any failures of the above steps
